now.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
now.text: Kingpin shoots him for it, and Aaron apologizes to Miles before dying in his arms.

changes.evidence: Aaron is shot and dies in Queens, not Brooklyn: the Prowler chases Miles from the fight at Aunt May's house (Forest Hills, Queens), unmasks him, and Kingpin shoots Aaron from a car; Miles carries him into an alley where he apologizes and dies (marvel.fandom Aaron Davis (Earth-1610B): PlaceOfDeath = Queens; 'eventually leading him to Queens'; the ITSV film page lists Aunt May's House under Queens > Forest Hills). The closest place the app already uses is Aunt May's house (Earth-1610), as in Miles's k0; if the owner prefers, the place can simply be dropped. Note: k0 of this file (not drawn) has the same Brooklyn tag for the same chase.
